name: Sentinel-1 GRD on AWS Open Data (bucket sentinel-s1-l1c)
what_it_gives: Sentinel-1 Level-1 GRD (IW, EW, SM) as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs; anonymous HTTPS and range reads; static STAC items in bucket sentinel-s1-l1c-stac; SNS topic for new scenes. This is the imagery source the repo uses now (scripts/02_search_scenes.py).
spatial_temporal_coverage: Global, 2014 to 2026-10, includes S1C and S1D. Measurement TIFFs are COGs (1024 px deflate tiles, overviews, 210 GCPs). Ca Mau AOI (103.5-106.0E, 7.5-9.8N), 4 Jul to 2 Oct 2026: 50 IW GRD scenes, all S1D, none S1C; 30 ascending, 20 descending; relative orbits 18, 26, 91, 99; median revisit 4 days. Gulf of Tonkin AOI (105.6-108.2E, 19.0-21.6N), same window, bounding-box overlap: 78 scenes (67 S1D, 11 S1C); each S1C scene overlaps at most 0.3% of the AOI; S1D median overlap 13%, best 44%; 40 S1D scenes overlap 5% or more, on 16 dates (median gap 5 days, maximum 12). Whole bucket on 2026-09-28: 433 S1C and 540 S1D IW GRD products, so the S1C gap over both AOIs is not an ingestion gap. Last S1A day in the bucket: 2026-06-29. Wider South China Sea AOI: see docs/scs_regional.md (repo, other agent: 835 S1D and 207 S1C IW products, 90 days; not recomputed here).
latency: Measured on 20 scenes (29 Aug to 29 Sep 2026): 2.1 to 8.2 h, median 3.5 h, from sensing stop to the S3 LastModified time of the product files. Registry text: added usually within a few hours of availability at Copernicus.
license_or_cost: Free; not requester-pays (registry). Terms: Copernicus Sentinel Data Legal Notice, 'free, full and open' (permitted uses: reproduction, distribution, communication to the public, adaptation; VERIFIED-SECONDARY via a GitHub copy of the notice). Credit line 'Copernicus Sentinel data [year]'. Third-party mirror managed by Element 84 (registry), so keep CDSE as the official fallback.
commercial_use_allowed: Yes (CDSE docs: Sentinel data are free of charge to all users including commercial users)
verification_status: VERIFIED (direct S3 listing and range reads on 2026-10-02; AWS registry YAML; latency measured from S3 timestamps; Ca Mau search with scripts/02_search_scenes.py; Gulf of Tonkin search with a scratch replica of the same logic that reproduces the Ca Mau result exactly).
source: https://sentinel-s1-l1c.s3.amazonaws.com/ ; https://sentinel-s1-l1c-stac.s3.amazonaws.com/ ; https://github.com/awslabs/open-data-registry/blob/main/datasets/sentinel-1.yaml ; https://github.com/eu-cdse/documentation/blob/publish/Data/SentinelMissions/Sentinel1.qmd ; repo files data/s1_scenes.csv, data/s1_search_summary.json, docs/scs_regional.md
